title: Williams's teaching of breathing, and his son George and daughter Bella
summary: Williams taught breath control; son George was a multi-instrumentalist and Bella a pianist.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah. Because the show boats used to get out and turn it off. I was going to ask you to go back to Claiborne Williams again. Oh yeah. So many people have told us what a wonderful musician he was. But I've never even met any of his sons or anyone. If you can tell us any more. You mentioned how he taught you on breathing. Was any particular thing, was it using your diaphragm or deep breathing or what did he teach you?

Yeah, on how to take the breath. How to take your breath. Filling up the stomach. Filling up the stomach, surely, yeah. Just like those fellas who hold that note so long, you know? Yeah. That's what he was teaching me that.
The main particular thing. He has a son who's a wonderful musician also. By the name of George Williams, you ever heard of him?
Yes, I've heard of him. He was down here I think four or five years ago for a while.

He was. He played, he played, he played most all the instruments like his father. He played piano, trumpet, saxophone, beautiful tone in the saxophone. A wonderful musician. His sister, her name was Bella. Piano player, a wonderful piano player.
